select h.bp_id, case when h.customer_number is not null then '2' else '1' end oprtn_ind,--操作标识 h.customer_number as cst_no,--总行客户号 h.bp_name as cst_nm_s,--客户名称 h.registration_num_type as inst_ident_tp,--机构证件类型 h.register_cert_num as ident_no,--证件号码 case when h.registration_num_type='07' then h.register_cert_num else null end unifd_socl_crdt_cd,--统一社会信用代码 h.head_office_bp_type cst_tp,--客户类型 h.overseas_customer_name as ovrs_cst_chin_nm,--境外客户中文名称 (select hd.country from hls_bp_master_address hd where hd.bp_id=h.bp_id and hd.address_type='REGISTERED_ADDRESS')rgstrtn_cty_and_dstc_cd,--国家和地区代码 h.business_area as maincorprtnactvctyordstccd,--主要经营活动所在国家/地区 h.economic_indu_classify as cst_lo_natl_std_idy,--客户所属国标行业 h.swift as swiftno,--SWIFT BIC h.enterprise_affiliation as entp_atch_rltnp,--企业隶属关系 h.bp_financial_type as ecnm_tp,--经济类型 h.legal_person as lgl_rprs_nm,--法定代表人/经营者名称 h.business_scope as corprtn_scop1,--经营范围 nvl(h.credit_customer,'N') as crdt_cst_flg,--信用客户标志 h.bp_type as org_cust_type--机构客户类型 from hls_bp_master h where 1=1
and h.bp_id = #{bpId}
